outlook.title: Offshore of Southwestern Mexico
outlook.summary: An area of low pressure could form well offshore of southwestern Mexico over the weekend. Gradual development is possible during the early to middle part of next week as the system moves west-northwestward at 10 to 15 mph, and is likely to remain well offshore of Mexico.
